desc:
🍪 Welcome to Eat 1 Million Cookies! 

🎉 Use code "100K" in the Shop for 50 FREE Diamonds!

How to Play:
🍪 Fill your belly - the more you eat, the FATTER you get
🥛 Dunk your cookies in the milk machine for CASH
🧲 Unlock powerful tools - Magnet, Vacuum, Drill and more
🌈 Find rare purple and RAINBOW cookies worth way more
👑 Roll for classes - they make you OP
💎 Earn Diamonds from quests and daily rewards
👥 Squad up with friends (up to 4 players) or hit FIND SQUAD to team up with anyone
🔓 Can you make it all the way down and open the VAULT?

👍 LIKE + join the group for 3 FREE class rolls!
🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
